d:
When Wayne Gretzky made the switch from traditional wood to Easton's aluminum hockey stick in the early 1990s, he helped usher in a new era of hockey equipment innovation.
'The Stick That Changed the Game' is an NHL Productions mini-documentary exploring the incredible story of the Easton HXP5100, the technology that helped transform the sport, and the lasting influence of one of the most recognizable pieces of equipment in hockey history.
